notes.title: Demo v1.01 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed bug allowing serves to be returned before the ball bounced.


Balance Adjustments

 Narrowed strike zone for half-volleys.
 Adjusted backspin groundstrokes to be slightly better at handling shots with high incoming velocity.
 Adjusted backspin groundstrokes to be slightly better at handling shots above the strike zone.
 Adjusted how CPUs decide whether or not to let the ball bounce.
